decisions.reason: As a flagship 2019 range that sits squarely in the firm's core safety-footwear and climate/comfort know-how, it is highly related to existing capabilities and therefore likely to be improved and retained rather than withdrawn.

The electrostatic-dissipative occupational shoe fits the firm's established protective-footwear knowledge and technical product development, though its more specialised niche makes rationalisation somewhat more plausible than for the flagship line.

A new safety shoe series is close to the firm's main competence base and broad market offer, so under an absorptive-capacity logic management would usually keep it on the market and refine it unless early sales were clearly weak.
